snippet.description:
CJP Protest Update : 7 बजते ही दिल्ली में  बदल गए हालात! | Delhi Protest | Abhijeet Dipke | Neha Bora | Rahul Gandhi | Akhilesh Yadav | Mamata Banerjee

#CJPProtest #live #CJP #DelhiProtest #AbhijeetDipke #NehaBora #RahulGandhi #AkhileshYadav #MamataBanerjee #protest 

Regarding the demand for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, major leaders of CJP who had announced a protest at Jantar Mantar in Delhi have been taken into custody. Abhijit Dipke, Ranka, Saurabh, and YouTuber Dhruv Rathee are currently in police custody. Protesters trying to reach Jantar Mantar have been taken into custody by the police, who acted strictly. There is heavy security deployed at every nook and corner in Delhi for the Jantar Mantar protest. 38,000 security personnel have been deployed, and the area is being monitored by drone cameras. Internet has been shut down in a 4-km radius around Jantar Mantar, and protesters are being detained. Overall, the police’s full preparations have overpowered the CJP protest. Delhi was on high alert in view of the demonstration. Markets have now started opening, and traffic is returning to normal on many routes in Delhi. The administration is working to restore train services. As a precaution due to the protest, several trains had been cancelled and metro services had been suspended.

snippet.title: Donald Trump shocks world: 3 दिसंबर को किस मुस्लिम को लाइव TV पर गोली मारेगा अमेरिका !
snippet.description:
Donald Trump shocks world: 3 दिसंबर को किस मुस्लिम को लाइव TV पर गोली मारेगा अमेरिका ! 

अमेरिका ने एक ऐसा ऐलान किया है जिसने पूरी दुनिया में हड़कंप मचा दिया है, 3 दिसंबर को अमेरिकी सेना का फायरिंग स्क्वाड एक मुस्लिम शख्स को दोपहर 1 बजे गोली मारेगा और इसे लाइव दिखाया जाएगा, दुनियाभर के मुस्लिम इस घटना से चौंक गए है मगर बहुत ज्यादा विरोध नहीं करते दिख रहे, भारत के वामपंथी और मुस्लिम भी इस मुद्दे पर बहुत आवाज नहीं उठा रहे क्युकी शायद अमेरिका और भारत के रिश्ते बेहद खराब चल रहे है, दरअसल अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प ने पूर्व अमेरिकी सैनिक निदाल हसन को गोली मारकर मौत की सजा देने का आदेश दिया है। निदाल मलिक हसन अमेरिकी सेना में एक मेजर और मनोचिकित्सक के पद पर तैनात था, लेकिन ये खुद मानसिक तौर पर इतना कट्टर बन गया की इसने 2009 में टेक्सास के सैन्य अड्डे पर धार्मिक नारा लगाते हुए गोलीबारी की थी, जिसमें 13 लोगों की मौत हो गई थी। निदाल हसन निजी पिस्तौल लेकर फोर्ट हुड सैन्य अड्डे पहुंचा और सैनिकों व अन्य लोगों पर अचानक गोलीबारी कर दी। यह अमेरिकी सैन्य अड्डे पर हुई सबसे घातक सामूहिक गोलीबारी थी। 

The US has made an announcement that has caused a stir worldwide: on December 3rd at 1:00 PM, a US Army firing squad will execute a Muslim man by shooting him, and the event will be broadcast live. Muslims across the globe are shocked by this development but do not appear to be voicing strong opposition; even leftists and Muslims in India are not raising their voices much on this issue, perhaps because relations between the US and India are currently strained. In fact, US President Donald Trump has ordered the execution by firing squad of former US soldier Nidal Hasan. Nidal Malik Hasan had served as a Major and psychiatrist in the US Army, but he became so radicalized that in 2009, he opened fire at a military base in Texas while shouting religious slogans, killing 13 people. Armed with a personal pistol, Hasan arrived at the Fort Hood military base and suddenly opened fire on soldiers and others; this was the deadliest mass shooting to occur at a US military base.

snippet.description:
Dad Hid His Lottery Secret Money... Then Leo and Maya Told Mom Everything! | Slow English Listening (A2)

Practice English listening with this easy Slow English Story for Beginners. In this story, Ethan wins the lottery but decides to keep the money a secret from Grace. What seems like a simple plan soon turns into a funny family problem!

Ethan keeps moving his hidden money to different places because he doesn't want Grace to find it. But Leo and Maya accidentally discover his secret. Worried that they might tell their mom, Ethan makes them a tempting promise in exchange for their silence.

The next morning, the family goes shopping, and things don't go quite as Ethan planned. Leo and Maya have their own ideas, and their father's secret may not stay hidden for much longer!

What will happen when Grace learns about the money? And can Ethan fix the situation before it causes a bigger problem?

দিল্লির বিক্ষোভ ঠেকাতে বিমান থেকেই আটক করা হলো ককরোচ জনতা পার্টির প্রতিষ্ঠাতা অভিজিৎ দীপকেকে। দলটির আরও দুই নেতা সৌরভ দাস ও আশুতোষ রাঙ্কাকেও ধরে নিয়ে যায় পুলিশ। অন্যদিকে, গুরুগ্রাম থেকে আটক করা হয়েছে আলোচিত কন্টেন্ট ক্রিয়েটর ধ্রুব রাঠীকেও। দিল্লির বিভিন্ন স্থানেও চালানো হচ্ছে ধরপাকড়। শহরের মোড়ে-মোড়ে চলছে আমর্ড পুলিশের তল্লাশি। এদিকে, সিজেপির তিন শীর্ষ নেতা আটক হওয়ায় এখন আন্দোলনে নেতৃত্ব দেবেন আজিঙ্কিয়া সিন্ধে। শুক্রবার, ধারণকৃত এক ভিডিওতে এই বার্তা দিয়েছেন অভিজিৎ। যা তার আটকের পর প্রকাশ করা হয়।

Abhijit Dipke, founder of the 'Cockroach Janata Party', was detained right off his flight in an effort to prevent protests in Delhi. Police also took into custody two other leaders of the party, Sourav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. Meanwhile, prominent content creator Dhruv Rathee was detained in Gurugram. Crackdowns are underway across various locations in Delhi, with armed police conducting searches at intersections throughout the city. With the detention of the CJP's three top leaders, Ajinkya Shinde will now lead the movement; Abhijit conveyed this message in a pre-recorded video released after his detention.
